'''Shurgg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] thief who worked for the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Pal-Nada]] at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. The Cerean operated a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] theft operation and on multiple occasions, he used a front organization called [[Interplanetary Acquisitions]] to distract starship owners while Shurrg disguised herself as a port authority safety officer and stole the distracted owners' ships.
